title: DocGuard ci result
description: The decision fields of `docguard ci --format json`, specs/106-field-report-fixes FR-011 and FR-012. Gate on `exitCode` or `outcome`. `guard.status` is guard's own word and does not include the ci gates (threshold, --fail-on-warning, strict unexamined).

exitCode.description: The process exit code: 1 FAIL, 2 WARN, 0 PASS.

outcome.description: blocked: a gate stops the pipeline (assessment.reasons says which).
